title: Introducing the Hoppscotch MCP Server
description: The Hoppscotch Model Context Protocol (MCP) server lets an AI agent in a host such as Claude Code or Cursor drive your collections, requests, environments, and teams, run real API requests, and generate code, across Cloud or self-hosted offerings.
